stories.title: The Birthmonth Of Mr Sadness
stories.description: Nobody knows when or where Mr. Sadness was born, but one year ago he found his way to the invisible Mushroom House and quietly became part of its family. He is a shy, gentle creature who rarely asks for anything, yet whenever Mei opens the door for afternoon tea, he appears with his small smile and settles among the others. Sometimes he gathers nuts from the forest as gifts; sometimes he washes the cups, arranges the kettle, or tends the stove, offering whatever kindness his little hands can manage. Because no one knows his real birthday, the Mushroom House decides to celebrate the entire month in which he first found his home. There will be tea, warm bread, little presents, and plenty of ordinary afternoons together, without requiring Mr. Sadness to become any louder or happier than he wishes. His birthmonth is a celebration not of sadness disappearing, but of a quiet being finding a place where he is loved exactly as he is.
